headline: Franklin Resources, Inc. Announces Preliminary Month-End Assets Under Management
summary: SAN MATEO, Calif., August 05, 2026--Franklin Resources, Inc. (Franklin Templeton) (NYSE: BEN) today reported preliminary month-end assets under management (AUM) of $1.80 trillion at July 31, 2026, compared to $1.79 trillion at June 30, 2026. This month’s increase in preliminary AUM reflected long-term net inflows of $6 billion and the positive impact of markets.

headline: Franklin Resources (BEN) Is Becoming Franklin Templeton After A Bylaws Change
summary: Franklin Resources, trading as NYSE:BEN, is changing its corporate name to Franklin Templeton. The company has amended its bylaws to reflect the new identity. The move aligns the corporate entity with the Franklin Templeton brand used across its global asset management business. Franklin Resources operates as a global asset management company under the Franklin Templeton brand, serving a wide base of institutional and retail clients.
